label: projekt-bas-app Neutral
description: Neutral minimal variant for Scaffold: Av — thin Next.js app baseline without product chrome.
signatureMotif: blank app canvas, calm tokens, and room for the prompt to define the product
promptHints: Stay minimal until the prompt defines a domain — no invented sidebar, dashboard, or marketing sections.
Prefer a clean single entry screen, then grow routes and components from the user's request.

layouts: Start from a single primary screen with clear hierarchy; add routes only when the prompt needs them.
Keep the first viewport calm: one title, one short supporting line, and space for the product UI to emerge.
Use a simple full-width content column with consistent spacing — no forced multi-section marketing stack.
motifs: Neutral surfaces with a single restrained accent color, comfortable spacing, and a readable typographic hierarchy.
Soft consistent corner radius and light borders so components read as calm and extension-friendly.
antiPatterns: Avoid hero+CTA marketing landings, feature-card grids, sidebars, or dashboards unless the user asked for them.
Do not lock in a strong niche aesthetic; keep the expression flexible until the user's actual domain is known.
